meaning: Body or query does not match the schema (missing field, bad ULID, bad date).
tillDoes: Shows message; retries at the next scheduled time. Never drops data.

details.field: name of the first bad field

meaning: Same Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.
tillDoes: Logs it and makes a new key (a till bug).

meaning: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.
tillDoes: Waits Retry-After (5 s when none), then repeats with the same Idempotency-Key and the same body. Never store this reply under the key.

meaning: Bearer key unknown.
tillDoes: Stops calling with this key; shows 'API key rejected'. For licence/validate the day counts as not validated.

meaning: Key was valid but is revoked (branch deactivated, key rotated more than 7 days ago).
tillDoes: As auth.invalid_key; shows 'This till is no longer linked - re-link it'.

meaning: X-SSPOS-Branch-Id is not the key's branch.
tillDoes: As auth.invalid_key.

meaning: X-SSPOS-Contract not served at this path.
tillDoes: Stops; shows message (update the till).

meaning: The till's X-SSPOS-App-Version is below the portal's minimum for this endpoint.
tillDoes: Shows 'Update the till'; keeps trading on its current licence token.

meaning: More rows or bytes than accepted.
tillDoes: Halves the batch and retries.

meaning: One row cannot be stored; rejectedKey names it.
tillDoes: Shows the row on Sync status; retries next run.

meaning: Too many requests.
tillDoes: Waits Retry-After / retryAfterSeconds.

meaning: Portal overloaded or in maintenance.
tillDoes: Waits Retry-After, then backoff.

meaning: Unexpected portal fault.
tillDoes: Backoff and retry; licence/validate counts as not validated that day.

meaning: No such activation or transfer code.
tillDoes: Shows 'Code not recognised - check the email'.

meaning: The code is past its expiry.
tillDoes: Shows message with the portal link to send a new code.

meaning: The code was already used by another install (same install within 24 h gets the same 200 reply instead).
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Too many wrong codes from this address or install.
tillDoes: Disables the Link key for retryAfterSeconds.

meaning: The till holds trading data for other ids; it must call cloud/migrate.
tillDoes: Switches to the migrate flow (asks the owner first).

meaning: The code's branch already has an active main till.
tillDoes: Shows 'This shop is already linked to KIRKGATE-TILL1 - release it first (portal or old till)'.

meaning: registerId is not a register of this branch.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: X-SSPOS-Register-Id is not the branch's main till (and the body does not report it as main).
tillDoes: Logs; the call is repeated from the main till.

meaning: Activating would exceed maxRegisters. licence/activate: the branch already has maxRegisters tills bound (section 17.15.1 step 4a).
tillDoes: Shows message; nothing is linked.

meaning: The account's licence is revoked or suspended.
tillDoes: Shows message and the support number.

meaning: Portal key unknown. On licence/validate (per till): no licence bound to that installId.
tillDoes: Shows 'Key not recognised'.

meaning: Portal key already used by another branch.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Portal key not redeemed in time.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Key or token is for another company/branch.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Portal policy refuses this key here (e.g. a local token on a cloud till).
tillDoes: Keeps the current licence; shows message.

meaning: Not SSPOS1.<payload>.<signature>, or payload not JSON.
tillDoes: Shows 'Key damaged - paste it again'.

meaning: Signature does not verify.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: The token's signing key is not built into the till and its signerCert is not a valid approval: not SSPOSCERT1., approvedBy not in approverKids, the approver's signature fails, the certificate kid differs from the token kid, or the token was issued after the certificate's expiresAt (17.17).
tillDoes: Shows 'made by a licence server SSPOS has not approved'. Also the till's own verdict on a token you return.

meaning: kid not known to the portal.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Local token past expiresAt (for migrate: nothing to carry over; the request may still succeed without it).
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Local token's installCode is not this install's.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Token v is newer than the portal understands.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: Portal token for another company/branch.
tillDoes: Shows message.

meaning: These company/branch ids already belong to another portal account.
tillDoes: Shows message and support number.

meaning: Unknown or expired uploadId.
tillDoes: Calls cloud/migrate again (same code, same install) to get a fresh upload.

meaning: Upload already completed.
tillDoes: Stops the initial upload; resumes normal push.

meaning: The key is bound to another installId. The same installId gets 200 instead.
tillDoes: Shows the message (put the other PC's deviceName in it); nothing changes.

meaning: A local key (keyType token) whose licenceId the portal first recorded from another installCode (open local key copied to a second PC). The same installCode again gets 200 recorded.
tillDoes: Stores the key's hash as withdrawn and locks after the sale in progress: 'This key is already used on another PC - contact your dealer'. Only a new key unlocks.

meaning: The till sent company/branch ids (existingIds on activate, the X-SSPOS-Company-Id / X-SSPOS-Branch-Id headers on validate) that are already bound to another licence or shop. The portal alerts the admin. Portal v1.4.1.
tillDoes: Changes nothing. Activate: shows message (or 'This till's shop details are already linked to another licence ... call your dealer'); nothing is saved. Validate: keeps trading on the token it holds (the grace keeps running) and shows a 'Licence details need checking' warning with message. Never locks the till by itself.

meaning: Optional name for an unknown sync key typed at Connect (the till treats activation.code_not_found, key.not_found and auth.invalid_key the same way).
tillDoes: Shows 'The portal does not know this sync key. Check it was copied in full from your online dashboard account.' Nothing is saved.

meaning: Optional name for an expired sync key (as activation.code_expired).
tillDoes: Shows 'This sync key has expired. Make a new one on your online dashboard account, then press Connect again.' Nothing is saved.

meaning: Optional name for a sync key already linked to another shop (as activation.code_used / device.branch_already_linked).
tillDoes: Shows 'This sync key is already in use by another shop. Each shop has its own sync key.' Nothing is saved.
